name: SBFT 2025 Java Test Case Generation Track
description: This short report presents the 2025 edition of the Java Unit Testing Competition in which four test generation tools (EVOFUZZ, EVOSUITE, BBC, and RANDOOP) were benchmarked on a freshly selected set of 55 Java classes from six different open source projects. The benchmarking was based on structural metrics, such as code and mutation coverage of the classes under test, as well as on the readability of the generated test cases.
reputation: A niche but relevant benchmark in software testing research, mainly used to compare automated Java test generation tools rather than general-purpose ML systems.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on Java unit test generation; small benchmark size and tool-specific evaluation, with readability assessed alongside structural coverage.
